issues.issue: The county treasurer balance is printed below the Exhibit A grid, outside the line 26-28 'Ending Balance Consists Of' block, and is not recorded. The rules make county treasurer cash Cash and Cash Equivalents. It is left out of the village's line 28 total, so omitting it is defensible, but a person should confirm.

No equity lines are recorded (equity is []), but total_equity is set to the line 28 asset subtotal so the balance check holds. That figure is an asset subtotal, not a printed equity total. This assumption is acceptable for a waiver form.

ending_cash (46,518.86) and beginning_cash (37,376.26) are the cash-plus-investments subtotals, and the investments are also filled in separately (22,545.30 / 22,493.67). This is informational under the cash-basis rule, but anyone who adds cash and investments together will count the investments twice.
